long_description:
Lightski implements AI agents to replace document-heavy enterprise workflows. One document-heavy customer now processes intake in 10 minutes instead of 2 days, with a > 5x decrease in cost. 

To do so, we audit and rebuild the entire substrate your business runs on, native to AI. From document-heavy intake to back-office execution, automatically drive your top line with Lightski agents.
